segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to confirm the rollout details for the asset tracking module and make sure the quote matches what your team needs for Q2.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We’re still at 64 seats for the first phase. That’s 52 field users, 8 managers, and 4 admins. Go-live target is May 13, assuming procurement gets the order out by next Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. I have 64 seats in the CRM, annual term, starting May 1 with service access enabled May 13. The subscription is $38,400 for the year, and implementation is a one-time $7,500.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That matches what I saw. One question on implementation, does that include the two data imports from our current spreadsheet process?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. The standard package includes two imports, configuration of the approval workflow, and three admin training sessions. If you need a third import later, the pricing sheet has that at $1,200.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that’s fine. Billing-wise, can you split the invoice? Finance wants subscription on one line and services on another, same invoice is okay.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, no issue. I’ll note that for billing: separate line items, same invoice, net 30 terms. Your procurement contact is still Marcus Lee?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, Marcus is the buyer. Please copy me and our ops director, Jill Patel, when you send the order form.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send it over today with the May 1 start date, 64 seats, annual term, net 30, and the implementation scope attached.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. If the order form looks right, I can get Marcus to route it Monday. Thanks.
